rules: No value classified Server-only secret may use a VITE_ prefix.
Staging must use an owner-confirmed non-production Supabase project and branch-scoped Preview variables.
Secrets are never printed by configuration diagnostics.
Missing optional provider credentials mean unavailable capability, never a simulated successful response.
